Agent.description: One agent in the dataset. Shipped as `agents.csv` at the dataset root, one row per agent: the mapping between the dataset-local `agent_index` and the global `agent_id`, plus core per-agent attributes.

age.description: Age of the agent at the start of the study, in years.
age.title: Age

agent_id.description: A unique identifier assigned to the agent (typically unique within a data collection institution or research group), used to determine whether the same agent participated in multiple studies. May be created using a custom procedure (e.g., a UUID).
agent_id.title: Agent Id

agent_index.description: The dataset-local label of the agent: the string `agent_` followed by a zero-padded ordinal (e.g., `agent_015`). It names the agent's data folder and is unique within the dataset.
agent_index.title: Agent Index

agent_type.description: The kind of agent that generated the data.
agent_type.title: Agent Type

language.description: Primary language of the agent, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g., `en`, `fr-BE`).
language.title: Language

sex.description: Sex of the agent, as recorded by the study.
sex.title: Sex
